status: outcome-blind execution amendment after an unscored serving failure

amendment.trigger: One request exhausted both frozen attempts without returning final JSON after 83 valid predictions had been written.
amendment.outcome_access: Protected labels had not been opened or scored.
amendment.change: After the frozen retry limit, record neutral candidate scores, zero confidence, and an explicit abstention; retain and charge both failed attempts. Successful request payloads and all scientific comparisons remain unchanged.

scientific_question: Does outcome-blind retrieval of complete experimental panels improve environment selection on held-out studies or decisions beyond the same model using target measurements alone?
independent_unit: complete study or agentic-coding training decision

target_panel_selection.rule: Select panels with the smallest SHA-256 digest of study_id and panel_id; the rule never reads outcomes.

retrieval.eligible_history: panels from groups other than the held-out study or decision
retrieval.similarity: Jaccard similarity over outcome-free domain, metric, intervention, and measurement-field tokens
retrieval.tie_break: SHA-256 of the history study and panel identities
retrieval.outcome_rule: Outcomes are exposed only after an entire history panel has been selected.

model.retry_rule: Repeat the identical request once only when serving returns no valid final JSON. Record and charge every attempt.
model.selection_reason: Reuse the already qualified open baseline to isolate the value of the larger domain-centered archive and retrieved research history before comparing another backbone.

matched_text_baselines.selection_rule: Use the modal settings from the closed six-study replay; do not retune them on this domain benchmark.

claim_boundary: Retrospective development replay. Public-record exposure remains possible, the panel sample is outcome-blind but incomplete, and confidence is not a calibrated uncertainty estimate.
